#Handbook generated in 2026/06/13 14:46

#Command

Command usage notes:
  - Use @<UID> before or after a command to target another player.
  - Wrap arguments that contain spaces in quotes, for example "Sender Name".
  - Subcommands are case-insensitive.
  - <value> is required. [value] is optional.
  - x<count>, l<level>, and r<rank> are option-style arguments.
  - Long option aliases are supported: --count, --amount, --level, --rank, --eidolon, --superimposition.

/account
  Description:
    Manage accounts.
    Note: This command is untested. Use with caution!
  Usage:
    Usage: /account create <Username> <Email> [Password] [UID]
    Usage: /account create <Username> <Email> [--password <Password>] [--uid <UID>]
    Usage: /account setpassword <Username|UID|Email> <Password>
    Usage: /account setemail <Username|UID|Email> <Email> [verified:true|false]
    Usage: /account verifyemail <Username|UID|Email>
    Usage: /account ban <Username|UID|Email> <permanent|duration> [reason]
    Usage: /account unban <Username|UID|Email>
    Usage: /account baninfo <Username|UID|Email>
    Usage: /account reset [Username|UID|Email]
    Usage: /account delete <Username|UID|Email> confirm
    Usage: /account remove <Username|UID|Email> confirm
    Usage: /account role <Username|UID|Email> <Role>
    Usage: /account setrole <Username|UID|Email> <Role>
    Usage: /account roles
  Permission: command.account

/anno
  Description:
    Send a server popup announcement.
  Usage:
    Usage: /anno [duration] [frequency] <announcement content>
    
    Examples:
      /anno 10m Server restart soon
      /anno 2h 5m Double drops are live
      /anno @10001 10m Private notice
    
    Options:
      --duration <time>    How long the announcement remains valid. Examples: 30s, 10m, 2h, 3d
      --frequency <time>   How often the banner can reappear. Examples: 30s, 10m, 1h
  Permission: command.anno

/avatar
  Description:
    Set properties for player's owned avatars.
    When setting trace level, setting to level X sets all trace nodes to level X. If greater than the node's max allowed level, sets to max level.
    Note: -1 means all owned avatars.
  Usage:
    Usage: /avatar talent <AvatarID|-1> <trace level 0-10>
    
    Usage: /avatar get <AvatarID>
    
    Usage: /avatar rank <AvatarID|-1> <eidolon 0-6>
    
    Usage: /avatar level <AvatarID|-1> <level 1-80>
    
    Usage: /avatar path <AvatarID> <PathID>
  Aliases: /av, /ava
  Permission: command.avatar

/calyx
  Description:
    Toggle calyx override mode that replaces calyx battles with freesr file content.
  Usage:
    Usage: /calyx on
    Usage: /calyx off
  Permission: command.calyx

/clear
  Description:
    Remove unequipped light cones or relics from the target player's inventory.
  Usage:
    Usage: /clear equipment
    
    Usage: /clear relic
  Permission: command.clear

/debug
  Description:
    Debug battle setup and custom packet loading.
  Usage:
    Usage: /debug specific <StageID>
    
    Usage: /debug monster <MonsterID>
    
    Usage: /debug customP <PacketJsonPath>
  Permission: command.debug

/give
  Description:
    Give items to the player. Avatar IDs can be entered here, but traces, levels, and eidolons cannot be set.
  Usage:
    Usage: /give <ItemID> [x<count=1>] [l<level=1, 1-80>] [r<rank=1, 1-5>]
  Aliases: /g
  Permission: command.give

/giveall
  Description:
    Give the player all items of the specified type.
    avatar means characters, equipment means Light Cones, material means stackable materials, relic means relics, unlock means chat bubbles, phone wallpapers, avatars, train means Trailblazer's room contents, pet means pets, path means Paths for multi-Path characters.
  Usage:
    Usage: /giveall avatar r<Eidolon> l<Level>
    
    Usage: /giveall equipment|lightcone r<Superimposition> l<Level> x<Count>
    
    Usage: /giveall material [x<count=1>]
    
    Usage: /giveall relic l<Level> x<Count>
    
    Usage: /giveall unlock
    
    Usage: /giveall train
    
    Usage: /giveall pet [x<count=1>]
    
    Usage: /giveall path
  Aliases: /ga
  Permission: command.giveall

/help
  Description:
    Show help information. Console commands can target an online player with @<UID>.
  Usage:
    Usage: /help
    
    Usage: /help [command]
    
    Targeting: @<UID> <command> ... or <command> ... @<UID>
  Aliases: /h
  Permission: command.help

/hero
  Description:
    Switch the main character's gender/form.
    When switching gender, genderId 1 represents male, 2 represents female.
    When switching form, 8001 represents Destruction Path, 8003 represents Preservation Path, 8005 represents Harmony Path.
    Note: Switching gender will clear all optional Paths and Traces, and this operation is irreversible!
  Usage:
    Usage: /hero gender <genderId: 1=male, 2=female>
    
    Usage: /hero type <typeId: 8001|8003|8005|8007|8009>
  Permission: command.hero

/htl
  Description:
    Developer-only HoyoToonLua controls.
  Usage:
    Usage: /htl enable|pause|restore|toggle <script|all>
    Usage: /htl hotkey <script|all> <key>
    Usage: /htl skill <character> <skill> <level|All> [param] <value>
    Usage: /htl memosprite <character> <skill> <level|All> [param] <value>
    Usage: /htl talent <character> <point> <level|All> [param] <value>
    Usage: /htl talentstat <character> <point> <level|All> [stat] <value>
    Usage: /htl con <character> <con|rankId> <param> <value>
    Usage: /htl stat <character> <promotion|All> <stat> <value>
    Usage: /htl popup <message>
    Usage: /htl reload
  Permission: command.htl

/json
  Description:

  Usage:
    Usage: /json
    
    Usage: /json <filename|index|path>
    
    Usage: /json clear
    
    Usage: /json export [name] [format=true|false]
  Permission: command.json

    Usage: /kick
  Permission: command.kick

/lineup
  Description:
    Manage the player's lineup.
    Maze points can only be obtained two at a time.
  Usage:
    Usage: /lineup mp [amount=2]
    
    Usage: /lineup heal
  Permission: command.lineup

/mail
  Description:
    Manage player's mail
  Usage:
    Usage: /mail <Sender> <TemplateID> <ExpireDays> _TITLE <Title> _CONTENT <Content> _ATTACH <ItemID> [x<count>] [r<rank/eidolon>] [s<superimposition>] [l<level>] [p<promotion>] [t<talentLevel|max>] ...
    Usage: /mail all <Sender> <TemplateID> <ExpireDays> _TITLE <Title> _CONTENT <Content> _ATTACH ...
    Usage: /mail welcome [all]
  Permission: command.mail

/mission
  Description:
    Manage player's missions.
    Use pass to complete all currently ongoing missions. This command can cause severe lag. Try to use /mission finish instead.
    Use finish [SubMissionID] to complete a specific sub mission. Please browse the handbook for SubMissionID.
    Use finishmain [MainMissionID] to complete a specific main mission. Please browse the handbook for MainMissionID.
    Use running <-all> to get tracked missions. Add '-all' to show all ongoing and potentially stuck missions. This may produce a long list, please review carefully.
    Use reaccept [MainMissionID] to restart a specific main mission. Please browse the handbook for MainMissionID.
  Usage:
    Usage: /mission pass
    
    Usage: /mission finish [SubMissionID]
    
    Usage: /mission running <-all>
    
    Usage: /mission reaccept [MainMissionID]
    
    Usage: /mission finishmain [MainMissionID]
  Aliases: /m
  Permission: command.mission

/raid
  Description:
    Manage player's mission temporary scene
  Usage:
    Usage: /raid leave
    
    Usage: /raid reset <RaidID> <Level>
  Permission: command.raid

/relic
  Description:
    Manage player's relics.
    Main stat is optional, sub stats are optional, but at least one must exist.
    Level restriction: 1 ≤ Level ≤ 9999.
  Usage:
    Usage: /relic <RelicID> <MainAffixID> <SubAffixID1:SubAffixLevel> <SubAffixID2:SubAffixLevel> <SubAffixID3:SubAffixLevel> <SubAffixID4:SubAffixLevel> l<Level> x<Count>
  Permission: command.relic

/reload
  Description:
    Reload specified configuration.
    Configuration names: banner, activity, videokey, plugin.
  Usage:
    Usage: /reload <banner|activity|videokey|plugin>
  Permission: command.reload

/remove
  Description:
    Admin-only removal for owned characters and light cones.
  Usage:
    Usage: /remove character <AvatarID> confirm
    
    Usage: /remove avatar <AvatarID> confirm
    
    Usage: /remove lightcone <UniqueId|ItemID> confirm
    
    Usage: /remove equipment <UniqueId|ItemID> confirm
    
    Add --dry-run to preview the removal.
  Aliases: /rm
  Permission: command.remove

/scene
  Description:
    Manage player's scene.
    Note: Most of these are for debugging. Before using commands, ensure you know what you are doing!
    Use prop to set prop state. Get state list from Common/Enums/Scene/PropStateEnum.cs.
    Use unlockall to unlock all props in the scene (set all props that can be set to open state to open). This command may cause the game to load stuck at about 90%. Use /scene reset <floorId> to solve.
    Use change to enter a specific scene. To get EntryId, visit Resources/MapEntrance.json.
    Use reload to reload the current scene and return to the starting position.
    Use reset to reset all prop states in a specified scene. To get current FloorId, use /scene cur.
  Usage:
    Usage: /scene group
    
    Usage: /scene prop <GroupID> <PropID> <State>
    
    Usage: /scene remove <EntityID>
    
    Usage: /scene unlockall
    
    Usage: /scene unlockallgroup
    
    Usage: /scene change <entryId>
    
    Usage: /scene reload
    
    Usage: /scene reset <floorId>
    
    Usage: /scene fsv <Name> <Value>
    
    Usage: /scene gp <GroupID> <Name> <Value>
    
    Usage: /scene cur
    
    Usage: /scene near
    
    Usage: /scene forward <Distance>
  Permission: command.scene

/setlevel
  Description:
    Set player level
  Usage:
    Usage: /setlevel <level 1-70>
  Aliases: /level
  Permission: command.setlevel

/unlockall
  Description:
    Unlock all objects within the category.
    Use /unlockall mission to complete all missions. You will be kicked after use, and may get stuck in the tutorial upon re-login. Use with caution.
    Use /unlockall tutorial to unlock all tutorials. You will be kicked after use. Use for situations where the interface is stuck and you cannot act.
    Use /unlockall rogue to unlock all types of Simulated Universe. You will be kicked after use. Recommended to use with /unlockall tutorial for better results.
  Usage:
    Usage: /unlockall <mission|quest|tutorial|rogue|challenge|grid>
  Aliases: /ua
  Permission: command.unlockall

/unstuck
  Description:
    Teleport an offline player back to the default scene. Console/admin oriented; the target must be offline.
  Usage:
    Usage: /unstuck <offline UID>
  Permission: command.unstuck

/windy
  Description:
    Load and send Lua bytecode to the target player.
  Usage:
    Usage: /windy <lua path relative to the Lua folder>
  Permission: command.windy
